plain_language_summary: The approved normal installer could not create a second isolated CPython 3.12.10 on this host; it modified the existing same-version installation, so that route failed and was rolled back. This successor replaces only the interpreter artifact and construction method: it uses Python.org's official application-local embeddable ZIP beneath C:\Projects\Active, then vendors the exact same already-reviewed 20-wheel lock. It performs no Windows installation, PATH, registry, launcher, association, shortcut, administrator, or existing-Python mutation. Its main uncertainty is whether PyTorch, Rasterio, and their native libraries work correctly in this embedded layout; exact fresh-process preflight must fail closed.
question: Do you approve adoption of exact successor CPYTHON-3.12.10-EMBED-UV-0.10.7-TORCH-2.13.0-CPU-WINDOWS-X64-002, bound to inventory SHA-256 ae95bc3982766e996c0ec6cb15d4964738f1958f48b1eabe73d2e2d27b3e3967, official embeddable ZIP SHA-256 4acbed6dd1c744b0376e3b1cf57ce906f9dc9e95e68824584c8099a63025a3c3, and unchanged private lock SHA-256 66ef4a354db2a1e51bd6ebeca81844c1f71497c1f8164e27b99816da5ce2e081, for Active-only application-local construction and synthetic Milestone 2 preflight?

allowed_decisions.yes: Authorizes exact official ZIP and Sigstore download into Active-only private custody; hash verification; application-local extraction; vendoring only the unchanged hash-locked wheels; the minimal recorded python312._pth configuration; license capture; and CPU-only import, DLL/data discovery, subprocess, deterministic-algorithm, and synthetic compatibility preflight. It does not authorize benchmark access or substantive training, inference, evaluation, tuning, or publication.
allowed_decisions.no: Rejects this exact successor. No successor artifact is downloaded, extracted, vendored, or executed, and Milestone 2 remains blocked unless another exact runtime is separately proposed and approved.

grant_limits: No version substitution, dependency addition, source build, installer reuse, unverified artifact, or reuse of any prior virtual environment.

No credential, secret, purchase, paid service, terms acceptance, administrator access, system PATH or registry mutation, launcher, association, shortcut, OneDrive custody, or prior-repository mutation.
No benchmark pixel access and no substantive training, scientific checkpoint, inference, evaluation, metric, threshold, tuning, render, tag, or release.
Any hash, extraction, native import, data-path, subprocess, CPU-only, deterministic, serialization, or replay mismatch is retained and fails closed.
required_attestation: The reviewer is the Experiment Three owner and explicitly approves or rejects only the exact successor and bounded actions above after reviewing the failed route, identity, sources, licenses, custody, risks, and exclusions.
downstream_gate: A yes permits only M2-U004D exact successor activation. M2-U005 and later units remain dependency-ordered, and benchmark or scientific work remains prohibited in Milestone 2.
